messages:
lydia: quick sync - thinking about splitting the onboarding pipeline into a fast "scorecard" pass and a slower "deepbench" pass. want feedback on boundaries and artifacts to retain.

maria: sounds good. scorecard = pre-admit, must be <10s. deepbench async. scorecard outputs admit_score and a small repro bundle.

tom: agree. important to make scorecard deterministic and auditable. store score_breakdown as list of (check:score). no black boxes.

sree: on compat checks: run tokenizer roundtrip + special token map verify + a tiny embedding stability (8 vectors). if any invariant fails -> immediate hold/quarantine.

alex: storage policy: default keep pointers + minimal repro (prompt, token_ids, seed, model_fingerprint). only persist full binaries if org policy sets persist_binaries=true. pointers must be immutable (s3 version id).

jen: telemetry note: classify failures into transient/regression/invariant. transient -> retry 3x ephemeral. regression -> persist bundle + alert. invariant -> quarantine and manual sign-off.

lydia: ok tradeoff question: for score thresholds, propose: GA >=85, canary 70-85, hold 50-70, quarantine <50. make configurable per org.

maria: +1, plus require admit_policy.schema_version to allow future descriptor split (acceptance_policy vs runtime_profile).

tom: UX: Console should show admit_score trend per model and a replay button that launches a docker-lite runner from the minimal bundle. runner avoids fetching huge compiled kernels.

sree: implementation: we need a stable model_fingerprint = sha256(tokenizer_map + model_config + weights_checksum). use it to validate pointers and detect drift.

alex: on bench flow: quick-bench seeds should be fixed and produce a small reproducible artifact. deepbench runs wide seqlen tails and more vectors; results can retroactively adjust admit_score but require human-in-loop for demotion.

jen: action items: lydia draft RFC addendum with sample JSONs for repro bundle and admission descriptor, maria to review, tom+sree prototype docker-lite runner, alex cost estimate pointer vs persist binaries, jen telemetry spec.

lydia: i'll draft today and tag folks. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
